caption:
Every new AI chat starts from zero. It doesn't know your stack, your conventions or the folder it should never touch.

So write it down once. I keep a short context file in my repos. Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md automatically, and Cursor and Copilot have their own version.

Best habit: every time you correct the same mistake twice, add a line.

Save this and set yours up today.
